fw.steps: Putting a firmware on the device
fw.step1: Switch the device off and unplug the cable.
fw.step2: Hold the OK key and press the power key. The screen stays dark.
fw.step3: Plug the USB cable into the computer. A small drive appears.
fw.step4: Copy the .bin file onto the drive (below). Wait until the drive disappears by itself.
fw.step5: Press the power key to start.
fw.stock_hint: Keep a copy of the stock firmware: the same steps put it back.
fw.no_drive: No removable drive found. Follow the steps above, then look again.
fw.copy_confirm: Copy {file} onto {drive}? This starts the firmware update.
fw.copied: Copied. Wait until the drive disappears, then press the power key.
settings.title: Settings
dash.title: Overview
dash.none_text: Plug in a Yarrow detector with its data cable and connect it, or try the demo device without hardware.
dash.record_hint: The Hub keeps a per-minute record of what the device shows, so the statistics grow while it runs. Updated {time}.
dash.start_hint: The live reading is switched off. Press Start to read the device.
live.alarms_none: No reading reached an alarm level.
live.recorded: The dose rate is also kept as a per-minute record for the statistics.
stats.title: Statistics
stats.empty: Nothing recorded yet. Keep the device connected with the live reading on, or read its log on the Log page.
stats.typical: The average is in the usual range of natural background (about 50 to 200 nSv/h).
stats.below: The average is below the usual range of natural background.
stats.above: The average is above the usual range of natural background (about 50 to 200 nSv/h).
stats.histogram_hint: Hours spent in each class between the lowest and highest value.
stats.by_hour: Dose rate by hour of the day
stats.by_hour_hint: Mean value for each hour of the day (computer time).
wiz.title: Calibration wizard
wiz.intro: Finds the sensitivity of your own tube. Put the detector where another instrument shows the dose rate, let it count for a while and write the result to the device.
wiz.ref_text: Enter the dose rate another instrument, a certified source or an official station shows for the place where the detector will stay.
wiz.current: The device uses {sens} counts per minute for 1 µSv/h now.
wiz.bad_ref: Enter a dose rate above zero.
wiz.measure_hint: Do not move the detector. At background level it takes tens of minutes for a good value; with a source a minute is enough. Finish becomes available after 100 counts.
wiz.result_hint: Measured from {counts} counts in {minutes} minutes. The uncertainty is the counting noise only; a longer measurement makes it smaller.
settings.alarms_hint: The Hub warns on screen (and with a beep) when the dose rate reaches these levels. They belong to the Hub; the detector keeps its own levels.
settings.recording_hint: With these on, the Hub reads the device as soon as it is connected and keeps one value per minute, so the statistics fill up by themselves. Everything stays on this computer.
settings.privacy: Nothing is sent anywhere: the data lives in this program's folder on your computer.
